display.headline: We noticed something worth checking first.

verdict.label: WORTH A CHECK
verdict.line: Most likely nothing. Checked is better than guessed.
verdict.sub: We spotted a change that sits outside cosmetic care. It’s very often completely harmless — but we’d rather be careful with you than clever.

checks.v: The plate reads thin — bendy tips, shadows under light. It rebuilds; it just needs the cycle broken.

display.medical: We’re a nail studio, not a clinic, so we can’t diagnose — but we noticed a change in color or structure that’s best looked at by a dermatologist before any cosmetic treatment. It’s very often nothing; a quick check just gives everyone peace of mind. Bring this reading along if it helps.
